messages:
nina: Noticed a small but bad pattern in today's finalize: some customers (mostly mid-size) missing support contract credit line; others got two final invoices (one with credit, one without). sending an example.

prateek-eng: need example invoice id + customer id please.

nina: INV-2024-4120 / cust-mid-112. In Payments UI customer sees INV-2024-4120 (good) and INV-2024-4120-1 (no credit, higher total).

ops-bot: deployment deploy-billing-renderer:v3.14 completed at 2476008000 by ci-pipeline

billing-bot: finalize_batch:202404_run status=SUCCESS invoices_finalized=16210 duplicates_emitted=12

prateek-eng: quick triage: renderer attaches support_contract_credit via mapping service that reads customer_contracts table. mapping call goes to cache service contract-cache:v2. After deploy we saw cache warm window. hypothesis: cache miss leads to credit omitted. duplicate invoices imply finalize retry path produced second invoice without credit.

prateek-eng: reproducer locally: 
```
# pseudo
line_items = generate_line_items(order)
credit = contract_cache.get(order.customer_id)  # returns None on miss
if credit:
  line_items.append(credit)
emit_finalize(line_items)
# retry path can re-run before cache warmed -> another finalize without credit
```

sam-support: customers already filed 7 tickets. some paid the larger of the two invoices. we need to pause payout scheduling for batch 202404 and prepare credit memos.

elaine-finance: pausing payouts for affected cohort now. please provide a list of duplicate invoice ids. we will generate credit memos and route refunds for captured payments.

prateek-eng: hotfix proposal: fall back to DB lookup when cache returns miss; add finalize idempotency key (canonical_order_id) so retries do not create new invoice ids; and add an alert on contract-cache miss rate > 0.5% during finalize.

ops-bot: job invalidate-cache contract-cache:v2 requested by prateek-eng at 2476008300

billing-bot: recreate_previews job queued for affected invoices by prateek-eng at 2476008330

nina: quick validation on sample: after cache invalidate + DB fallback, re-finalized invoice for cust-mid-112 shows support credit present and totals match ledger.

prateek-eng: patch pushed at 2476008400 to add DB fallback and idempotency check. adding metric finalize_retry_new_id_count.

elaine-finance: approved customer comms template: "We found duplicate invoices and are issuing corrective credits where needed. No action required from you; refunds will be processed automatically if payment was captured." Will send to support for dispatch.

sam-support: holding outbound messages until finance confirms list. prioritizing customers who already paid.

prateek-eng: leaving a short log snippet for postmortem: 
```
ERROR finalize: contract-cache miss for cust-mid-112 at 2476008199; db_fallback=false -> emitted invoice INV-2024-4120-1
WARN finalize: retry created new invoice id because idempotency key missing for order ord-9921
```

nina: creating incident ticket with timeline, affected invoice ids, and diffs. will follow up once credits/refunds issued. thanks all. :thumbsup:
